geometry: constant velocity in last-received infrastructure LiDAR frame, followed by received last/current calibration pose transport; actual timestamp delta in seconds
reference_point: advance received affine-normalized reference by the same physical xy displacement as the box; preserve native received offset
quantization: inherited per-query per-field symmetric INT8 absmax/127, np.rint, FP32 scales
serializer: CTKR2X01 reliable ordered; independent geometry and latent flags; actual len(packet)
absent_id: retain received state within native session; no invented reinitialization or TTL
rng: reset seed 0 after model and loader iterator construction, before data flow; inherit native CUDA settings
reuse_B: only after complete official-val receiver tensor equality with frozen INIT_ONLY
new_D_reason: historical P1 uses different inference RNG placement; exact prediction equivalence is unproved
diagnostic_reference: current sender predictions used only after decoding for offline error reporting; no online correction
wire_scope: application packet including metadata, IDs, two flags and CRC; excludes TCP/IP/radio overhead as in V2
